tokens.source: transcript message.usage summed across 1083 usage-bearing assistant records in <home>/.claude/projects/<repo-slug>/<session-id>.jsonl (cached_input = cache_read + cache_creation; uncached_input = input_tokens; total_input = their sum; 462822 of the output tokens were thinking tokens). The figure is therefore a floor, not a total. See 'unproven'.

unproven: Command tails and sha256 values are SANITIZED, not verbatim: absolute paths become <repo> and <home> before hashing.
'commit' names 23e1c58, the substantive head, not the squash-merge commit GitHub creates at merge time. The directive-7 gates key on 'pr' for that reason.

The token figures are a FLOOR, not a total. They exclude all subagent spend, and they come from a measuring script written by the author of this record that no one has reviewed. A measured-looking number produced by an unreviewed instrument is an estimate wearing a measurement's clothes.

Directive 7a binds conduct, not code. Nothing in this repository enforces anything about the truth of a written or spoken claim; the independent reviewer confirmed no script does. Two gates to close that gap are being built and are NOT in this PR.

reviewer_id and commit_author_id are self-attested strings. Nothing cross-checks them against git authorship or a session registry, so reviews/16/ is an audit trail, not proof that two independent sessions existed.
